_: Boxes in design pt, x0 y0 x1 y1, on the capture named first. gen.py's cut() multiplies by SCALE (3.0 capture px per pt) and writes assets/art/<id>.png. p1 and p5 are read through gen.py's INPAINT: the chrome the boards draw again in CSS is patched out of the capture with a Coons fill before the crop is taken.
_rule: Only a photograph is cropped. Every rule, fill, glyph and run of type on these screens is rebuilt, so nothing here carries interface pixels. The two banners and the avatar are not here: 06 and 07 show the example account's own, which are in assets/ and placed by pic().
